descriptions.job-0bbnddp:
About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.

Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

We're hiring a capital markets professional to drive business development across both sides of our marketplace: sourcing and structuring assets off-chain, and building investor demand on-chain. Coverage spans Figure Connect, Figure Markets, $YLDS, Home Equity, and Automobile.

The role is deliberately hybrid. Roughly half the job is external, originating and managing relationships with clients, partners, and counterparties. The other half is internal, working alongside the capital markets team on execution and on the analytical and structuring work that supports live transactions.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and own relationships with asset originators and sellers on the supply side; support deal sourcing through structuring and execution
  • Build and deepen investor and counterparty relationships on the demand side, including on-chain distribution channels
  • Partner with internal capital markets, product, and legal teams to move opportunities from first conversation to closed transaction
  • Serve as an internal resource on market conditions, pricing, and counterparty feedback
  • Own post-close transaction operations, including servicing waterfalls, remittances, settlement reporting, and reconciliation to ensure accurate investor and originator cash flows

What We Look For

  • At least 3 years in capital markets, treasury, or structured credit (5+ preferred) at a lender, specialty finance platform, asset manager, or bank, with direct ownership of live transactions rather than support-only exposure
  • Demonstrated experience on both sides of a trade: sourcing and managing originator or seller relationships, and executing with investors and capital partners across whole loan sales, securitizations, forward flow, or warehouse and credit facilities
  • Deep credit and collateral fluency in real estate or consumer assets: residential transition, construction, DSCR, residential term, home equity, or auto; spanning underwriting guidelines, exposure limits, diligence, pricing, and valuation
  • Hands-on ownership of post-close operations, including servicing waterfalls, remittances, settlement reporting, net wire calculations, and reconciliation of investor and originator cash flows
  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, economics, or a related quantitative field; CPA, CFA, or Series 7/63/65 a plus
  • Advanced Excel modeling (pivot tables, macros, XLOOKUP/SUMIFS, XNPV,PMT/IPMT) plus SQL and a BI tool such as Tableau for pool-, portfolio-, and scenario-level analysis
  • Working knowledge of, or credible appetite to learn quickly, digital asset market structure, tokenized credit, and on-chain distribution
  • Client-facing presence and commercial instinct: able to open relationships cold, negotiate terms, and present to executives, boards, and counterparties
  • Ownership mentality and comfort with ambiguity on a lean team, with strong cross-functional collaboration across product, legal, and finance
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $96,000 - $144,000/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly 
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.
descriptions.job-059my0t:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Payouts and FX team helps global businesses manage their money wherever it flows. We own Stripe's FX and multi-currency management products—including FX Acquiring, Multicurrency Settlement (MCS), and Currency Conversion—which together serve tens of thousands of global merchants and platforms. Our team works at the intersection of payments, treasury, and financial infrastructure, helping businesses reduce FX costs, eliminate third-party dependencies, and consolidate their multi-currency operations onto Stripe.

What you'll do

In this role, you will own the full commercial cycle—prospecting, structuring, closing, and activating deals—across Stripe's FX Acquiring, Multicurrency Settlement (MCS), and Currency Conversion (ICC) products. You will engage CFO- and Treasurer-level stakeholders at global merchants and platforms, positioning Stripe's multi-currency suite as the complete alternative to standalone FX management providers. You will also serve as a product specialist for the broader Account Executive team, building the playbooks, deal structures, and GTM motion that scale this business.

Responsibilities

  • Own quota and commercial responsibility across FX Acquiring, Multicurrency Settlement, and Currency Conversion, prospecting and closing deals with global merchants and platforms
  • Structure and negotiate holistic multi-currency deals that bundle MCS and Currency Conversion, pricing across both products to deliver merchant value while capturing the full multi-currency management relationship for Stripe
  • Engage C-suite and treasury stakeholders—including CFOs, Treasurers, and Engineering leaders—to articulate Stripe's multi-currency value proposition and displace competitors managing FX flows off-platform
  • Serve as the FX and multi-currency GTM product specialist for the broader Account Executive team, partnering on complex deals and helping build repeatable sales motions
  • Build and execute go-to-market strategies for new product segments, including pitch frameworks, displacement playbooks, and bundled pricing approaches
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, treasury, and core account teams to support merchant activation, resolve deal blockers, and feed market intelligence back into product development

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure
  • Demonstrated knowledge of FX and treasury concepts across multiple geographies, including currency risk, settlement mechanics, and cross-border payment flows
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving finance and engineering leadership
  • Track record of consultative, product-led selling with demonstrated competitive displacement wins

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building a go-to-market motion for a new product or market segment, from initial targeting through to scaled execution
  • Familiarity with multi-currency account products, FX management platforms, or global treasury tooling

descriptions.job-0091ldp:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is looking for a senior product strategist-operator to support the Risk team. Risk is central to Stripe’s ability to grow safely: the team protects Stripe and our users while enabling durable, responsible growth. In this role, you will have a front-row seat to high-stakes business and product decisions and a direct hand in helping the team identify emerging risks, prioritize the right interventions, and deliver measurable outcomes. If you are a technical strategist who moves quickly, brings clarity to ambiguity, and stays with difficult problems through resolution, we’d love to hear from you.

You will partner closely with Risk leaders and cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Operations, and Strategy. You will create strategic clarity around Risk’s performance, connect business and product signals, pressure-test plans, and mobilize teams when results are off track. The role combines rigorous analysis with hands-on execution: you will not only identify where Stripe should act, but also help drive the work required to change the trajectory.

We are looking for someone who can connect risk signals, data, financial performance, user impact, and product and business strategy. You can find the signal in the noise, form a clear point of view, and either address the problem directly or convene the right people to solve it quickly.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will work across Risk and Stripe’s technical and user-facing teams to improve decision-making, strengthen execution, and help Stripe manage risk while serving users well.

Responsibilities

  • Own the signal: Define and maintain the metrics that matter for Risk’s in-year performance, spanning risk outcomes, business impact, operational health, and user experience. Build a disciplined “morning read”—a curated, high-signal view that surfaces emerging issues and drives timely action beyond standard dashboarding.
  • Lead deep-dive interventions: Run focused “surge” efforts to diagnose and unblock critical goals at risk. Move from symptom to root cause, align teams on the response, and stay engaged until the trajectory has measurably improved.
  • Bridge Risk, Product, and Strategy: Translate long-horizon company and risk theses into in-year priorities and operating plans. Decompose ambiguous opportunities and threats that cut across Product, Risk, Operations, and go-to-market teams into structured workstreams with clear owners and outcomes.
  • Synthesize for leadership: Anticipate the questions senior leaders will ask and prepare clear, decision-oriented materials that turn complex and unstructured risk signals into diagnoses, options, and recommended actions.
  • Pressure-test assumptions: Work closely with Risk, Corporate Strategy, Product, and Finance to test whether plans reflect external market dynamics, changing risk patterns, user needs, and Stripe’s execution capacity. Identify gaps early and help teams adapt.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 12+ years of experience in product strategy, business operations, data analytics, product management, or strategic business performance roles, ideally in high-growth technology companies
  • Experience in product strategy, product management, or GM-style roles with direct ownership of a P&L or a specific business outcome
  • Deeply curious about business models and data, probing into signals, understanding trends and customer usage patterns to uncover novel insights
  • A proven track record of directly driving business growth through analytical insights and execution
  • Demonstrated ability to apply AI to improve decision-making and operational efficiency, with sound judgment about when and how to use AI tools without sacrificing rigor or quality
  • Strong product sense and the ability to understand the technical mechanics of how software products are built and scaled
  • Experience navigating ambiguous, cross-functional problems and leading high-stakes interventions with senior stakeholders
  • Prior experience with fintech products or complex financial systems is a plus, but not required
  • Experience facilitating senior leadership and stakeholder discussions that lead to clear decisions and action on business performance

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in risk, payments, financial services, or fintech
  • Ability to build trust and partner with senior leaders and CXOs
  • Technical proficiency in SQL / Python / R and data analysis; ability to self-serve and perform independent deep-dives into complex datasets
  • Experience developing creative solutions and influencing the roadmaps of cross-functional teams
  • Ability to anticipate how product launches, policy changes, and go-to-market activity affect risk outcomes, user experience, and support operations
descriptions.job-0zir4l9:
Company

Founded by CPAs, tax attorneys, and engineers, Taxbit is the leading innovator automating global tax reporting for the digital economy. Taxbit's AI-enabled platform streamlines compliance related to digital assets, payments, and other financial transactions. Its unique combination of deep subject matter expertise and AI-forward technology have made it a fast-growing disruptor trusted by the world's leading fintechs, marketplaces, digital asset players, Big 4 accounting firms, traditional enterprises, and government agencies. Backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs, Taxbit's team is located across offices in San Francisco, New York, Seattle, Salt Lake City, London, Madrid, and Singapore.

Opportunity for Impact

TaxBit is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our Systems, Security & Compliance organization and take ownership of the cloud infrastructure that powers our platform. In this role, you will be a technical leader for our AWS environment, driving the architecture, automation, and operational excellence of systems that our customers and internal teams depend on. You will also help shape and drive our AI (Dev)Ops strategy, defining how we deploy, monitor, and operate AI-enabled systems responsibly and at scale. You will have broad influence over how we build, deploy, secure, and monitor infrastructure at scale, partnering closely with engineering, security, and compliance stakeholders to raise the bar on reliability, security, and developer velocity across the company.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate secure, highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS supporting TaxBit's platform and products
  • Own infrastructure-as-code using AWS CDK (preferred) or Terraform, driving consistency, repeatability, and version control across environments
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub/GitHub Actions) to enable safe, frequent, and reliable deployments
  • Define and implement TaxBit's backup and disaster recovery strategy across cloud data stores and critical systems
  • Architect and evolve data storage and processing patterns that support scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency
  • Implement and maintain centralized logging, monitoring, and observability across services and infrastructure
  • Implement and maintain security guardrails integrated throughout the development lifecycle
  • Build workflow automation that reduces manual toil in infrastructure provisioning, deployments, and operations
  • Debug and resolve complex issues across distributed, cloud-native systems, driving root-cause analysis and durable fixes
  • Implement AI Ops/AI DevOps practices to deploy, monitor, and operate AI-enabled systems and pipelines in production
  • Partner cross-functionally with engineering, security, and compliance teams using tools such as GitHub, Linear/Jira, and Databricks

Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. minimum) in Computer Science or a related field
  • Significant experience in systems/infrastructure engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in AWS cloud infrastructure
  • Strong programming skills in Python, TypeScript, or an equivalent language
  • Required: hands-on experience with CI/CD, GitHub, and Infrastructure-as-Code (AWS CDK preferred, Terraform acceptable)
  • Experience designing and implementing backup strategy, data architecture, and disaster recovery for cloud systems
  • Experience implementing and maintaining logging and monitoring/observability solutions
  • Security-minded, with experience implementing and maintaining security guardrails in engineering workflows
  • Experience with workflow automation and strong debugging skills across distributed systems
  • Familiarity with collaboration and workflow tooling such as Linear/Jira and Databricks
  • Familiarity with AI governance practices and frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001) for managing AI systems responsibly
  • Understanding of AI security risks and mitigations (e.g., model/data access controls, prompt injection, secure use of AI tooling)

Personal Characteristics

  • Security-minded by default, with a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risk
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability for systems end to end
  • Clear communicator who collaborates effectively across engineering, security, and compliance
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Pragmatic problem-solver who balances speed with reliability and security
  • Acts as an enabler for other engineers, building platforms, tools, and guardrails that make it easier for teams to ship safely and quickly
  • Collaborative by nature, building strong working relationships across engineering, security, and compliance to get to the best outcome together

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $170,000-$250,000. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Actual compensation will vary depending on various job-related factors, including, but not limited to location, experience, level, and job qualifications.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive cash compensation (based on experience)
  • Equity (RSUs)
  • Competitive benefits package
  • A modern 401(k) plan that includes access to crypto, financial wellness benefits, low fees and more
  • Hybrid working model: 3 days in-office, 2 days WFH/flexible
  • Monday team lunches, snacks and drinks
  • Discretionary Time Off - enjoy the flexibility to rest, refuel, and recharge
  • Paid parental leave to bond with your child
  • Fertility Benefit
  • Autonomous work and flexibility in how work is performed

Taxbit in the News 

  • Bybit Collaborates with Taxbit to Ensure Seamless Financial Compliance for Global and EU Users
  • Taxbit Expands Global Platform to Power CARF/DAC8 Compliance at Scale
  • Taxbit Unveils Industry-First Global Reporting Platform, Bridging Digital and Traditional Finance 
  • Taxbit Wins the Digital Banker’s 2025 Digital Assets Award for Best Technology Solution Provider for Digital Assets - Tax & Compliance Automation
  • Taxbit Named to 2024 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ List of Fastest-Growing Companies in North America
  • Taxbit Appoints Former OECD Advisor Colby Mangels as Global Head of Government Solutions
  • Unlocking Compliance at Scale: CARF/DAC8 Reporting for Digital Asset Platforms 

Disclaimers

  • By submitting an application for this role, you certify that the information contained in the application is correct to the best of your knowledge. You understand that to falsify information is grounds for refusing to hire you, or for discharge should you be hired. 
  • For US roles, employment with the Company is at will unless otherwise stated in a written agreement signed by the CEO of the Company.  This means that either the Company or the employee can terminate the employment at any time and for any reason, with or without notice.
descriptions.job-01yzcfx:
About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

Position Overview:

We are building a multi-region, 10,000+ GPU AI cloud infrastructure platform for external customers. As the platform scales rapidly across multiple data centers and geographies, we need a seasoned Cloud Project Manager to drive the end-to-end delivery of complex infrastructure and cloud platform software projects — from new data center builds and GPU cluster deployments to cloud platform software product development, feature launches, and cross-regional expansions. You will be the central coordination point across infrastructure engineering, software engineering, operations, vendors, and leadership, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the quality standards required for a mission-critical AI compute platform.

What you will be responsible for:

    • Own end-to-end project delivery for AI cloud infrastructure and cloud platform software initiatives: new data center builds, GPU cluster deployments (1K–100K GPU scale), network rollouts, cloud platform software product development, feature launches, and multi-region expansions.
    • Drive cloud platform software product project management: coordinate the delivery of control plane, tenant management, billing/quota, API/portal, scheduling, observability, and other platform software modules from requirements through release.
    • Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, timelines, milestones, resource plans, and risk registers; drive execution to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery.
    • Coordinate cross-functional teams — compute, network, storage, control plane, software engineering, DC operations, and vendor partners — to align on deliverables, dependencies, and integration points.
    • Manage vendor and contractor relationships (colocation providers, hardware suppliers, ISPs, system integrators); negotiate timelines, track deliverables, and resolve escalations.
    • Establish and run governance cadences: steering committees, sprint/release planning, weekly syncs, milestone reviews, and executive reporting.
    • Align infrastructure delivery and software development timelines to ensure integrated, end-to-end platform readiness for each region launch.
    • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and blockers proactively; drive issue resolution across organizational boundaries.
    • Define and enforce project management standards, templates, and processes (change management, RAID logs, status reporting, Agile ceremonies) to enable repeatable, scalable delivery.
    • Track and report project KPIs: delivery velocity, schedule adherence, budget variance, sprint velocity, and resource utilization.
    • Support capacity planning and demand forecasting by providing delivery timeline inputs to leadership.
    • Drive post-project reviews and lessons-learned processes to continuously improve delivery efficiency.

    How you will stand out:

      • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification preferred.
      • 7+ years of project management experience in cloud infrastructure, data center, or cloud platform software product delivery.
      • Proven track record delivering complex, multi-workstream projects — both infrastructure (data center builds, large-scale compute/network deployments) and cloud platform software products (control plane, billing, API/portal, scheduling) — on time and within budget.
      • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure components: compute (GPU/CPU servers), networking (Spine-Leaf, InfiniBand, SDN), storage, and data center facilities (power, cooling).
      • Solid understanding of cloud platform software architecture: multi-tenant control planes, Kubernetes, microservices, API design, CI/CD, and software release management.
      • Experience managing cross-regional or global infrastructure and software projects with distributed teams and multiple vendor partners.
      • Excellent stakeholder management skills; ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, senior leadership, and external partners.
      • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid); experience with tools such as Jira, MS Project, Confluence, or equivalent.
      • Strong risk management, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
      • Experience in AI/HPC infrastructure, GPU cloud, or hyperscale data center projects is strongly preferred.
      • Fluent in both English and Mandarin Chinese (written and spoken) — required for cross-regional coordination across global teams.

      What you will experience working with us:

      • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
      • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
      • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
      • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
      • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
      • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
      • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your Mission
This is a hands-on individual contributor role in the CEO Office. Reporting directly to the Chief of Staff, you operate at group level, driving the most consequential, cross-cutting special projects across the company rather than running a single function. You do the thinking and the building yourself, with the autonomy and senior exposure that comes with it.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Support with the CEO's and Chief of Staff's most important priorities, turning them into clear plans, decisions, and outcomes.
  • Participate in high-impact strategic projects end-to-end across the Group, from problem framing to delivered results.
  • Bring structured analysis, scenario modelling, and sharp recommendations to the Group's biggest strategic initiatives.
  • Be the person leadership can hand an ambiguous problem to with little context, and trust to structure it, own it, and return with a clear recommendation.
  • Create presentations, reports, forecasts, and financial models to support both internal and external stakeholders in strategic decision-making 

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree from a top-tier university with excellent grades.
  • First experience in strategy consulting, investment banking, corporate development / M&A, or a comparable role within a high-growth fintech or technology company.
  • Highly adaptable problem-solver, you take on any task, juggle multiple high-priority workstreams, and find a way to get them done.
  • A builder's mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists and standing up a new workstream from a blank page.
  • High discretion and strong interpersonal skills, you handle sensitive, confidential topics with sound judgement and build trusted relationships across the organisation with empathy.

What’s in it for you

  • Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.
  • Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.
  • Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.
  • Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.
  • Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.
  • Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.
  • Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.
  • Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.
  • Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.
  • Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.
  • Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

       .…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.
* These benefits may be adjusted at Bitpanda’s discretion and do not apply to our internships and exceptions to our Hybrid Working policy apply to teams with shift schedules or for folks whose roles require them to be in-office (think: Workplaces team or IT).
descriptions.job-1ty3am5:
Who we are

About Stripe

We're also a platform team, building the unified, fine-grained permissions model that every product at Stripe builds on.

AI agents are changing how businesses operate, and how they get authorized, governed, and secured is being defined right now—largely by us. We’re tackling challenging and unsolved problems for real businesses, like how to model agents when they blur the line between acting on behalf of a human vs. standalone principals, or how to authorize entire agent workflows rather than step-by-step actions. We’re collaborating directly with the frontier AI labs on the evolution of MCP, new identity protocols, and agent integrations. We build for solo founders and Fortune 500s alike, and the tension between those two is where the real product work lives.

What you’ll do

You'll set the vision and drive the roadmap for how every principal, human, agent, or app, gets access to a Stripe account. You'll do it by talking directly to the founders, admins, and developers who use it.

  • Design the experience of granting access, everywhere. Signing up, inviting a teammate, creating an API key, authorizing an agent or a third-party app.
  • Design for agents specifically. Design for agents as a new principal within Stripe, including how they authenticate, what they're allowed to do, and how businesses stay in control, including approvals and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for actions involving real money. You're defining an experience that will set the industry standard. 
  • Drive least privilege, made easy. Take holistic ownership across Stripe to ensure that every user, app and agent has only the permissions it requires. Build custom roles, smart permission defaults, and permission recommendations based on real API usage to make least-privilege authorization easy rather than tedious. 
  • Push toward a world without secrets. Make secretless authentication (Workload Identity Federation) the default way developers integrate with Stripe to prevent emerging security threats from increasingly sophisticated and AI-powered attackers. 
  • Partner across all of Stripe. Pitch an ambitious vision, then get teams across Dashboard, API Platform, Security, Payments and Money Movement genuinely excited to build it with you.

Who you are

The hardest part of this job, and the most fun, is the constant trade-off: usability vs. security, flexibility vs. simplicity. It takes taste to find a shape that feels effortless for a solo founder and holds up at Fortune 500 scale.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years in PM, shipping platform or infrastructure products that other teams build on
  • Background in security, identity, auth, or developer platforms, or serious curiosity about the space
  • A habit of talking to users to find the real problem, not the reported one
  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on authorization and authentication design
  • A bias toward experimentation over big-bang launches
  • Comfort setting direction in a space that's still being invented, across teams you don't manage

Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

Regulatory Engagement

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

Compliance Programme Development & Management

  • Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.
  • Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.
  • Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.

  • Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.
  • Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

AML/CFT & MLRO Duties

  • Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.
  • Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.

  • Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.
  • Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

Governance & Culture

  • Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.
  • Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.
  • Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.
  • Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.
  • Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

Reporting & Recordkeeping

  • Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.
  • Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.

    • Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

    Experience

    • Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.

    • Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit
    • Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.
    • Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

    Knowledge & Skills

    • Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)
    • Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.
    • Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Urdu.
    • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.
    • Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.
    • High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.
 

Nice to Haves

    • Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.
    • Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.
    • Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.
    • In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.
 

Additional Notes

This role will be subject to fit and proper assessment as part of the licensing process. Candidates must be prepared to undergo background checks, provide regulatory questionnaires, CVs, references, and proof of relevant qualifications. Prior enforcement history, regulatory sanctions, or unexplained gaps in professional record may affect eligibility.

Across our Product, Engineering, Design and Intelligence we’re going beyond giving everyone the tools. We’re setting new standards. Using AI to transform how we build and work every day to deliver on our market opportunity. Put another way our teams iterate alongside agentic systems applying judgement to build world class systems.

What that looks like for this role is set out below.

The impact you will have

Our data and intelligence platform sits at the heart of everything we do. As a senior engineer, you will personally design and build data systems that serve as the backbone of all Elliptic products. By collaborating across blockchain, intelligence and product teams, you will deliver innovative features that help the world fight financial crime and increase transparency in the crypto space. Very few engineering roles have such clearly measurable real-world impact.

You will also help us excel in engineering excellence by mentoring and upskilling our highly-engaged and passionate engineers, by championing best practices, and holding yourself and your team to a high standard.

What you will do

  • Explore and integrate new technologies (e.g. data orchestration or cloud-native tools) to optimise performance and scalability.

  • Take shared ownership of data systems, from design to deployment and ongoing improvement and support.

  • Perform thoughtful peer reviews that raise code quality and share best practices across the team.

  • Contribute to platform-wide initiatives that improve reliability, observability, and cost efficiency.

  • Help shape the technical roadmap for data engineering across Elliptic.

  • This role requires ‘Adoptive’ AI fluency. This means AI has already changed how you work, not just how fast. We expect you to enjoy leveraging AI and agentic systems to operate more effectively.

Tech environment

Scala | Spark | Databricks | AWS | Claude | Airflow | Kubernetes | Terraform | Functional Programming

You will thrive here if you

  • Enjoy end-to-end ownership, from writing the code to architecture design to coaching others through delivery.

  • Strive for engineering excellence and scalable, sustainable systems.

  • Use data and experimentation to guide decisions.

  • Communicate openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Support and coach less-experienced engineers.

  • Believe every challenge is an opportunity to simplify and innovate together.

  • Enjoy working with AI to benefit the company, your team and yourself.

What we are looking for

  • Ability to design, build, and maintain distributed data systems in a cloud-based environment.

  • Hands-on experience with big data frameworks such as Spark or Databricks.

  • Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Judgement to balance scalability, performance, and maintainability.

Bonus points for

  • Hands-on experience with functional Scala.

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

  • Experience working in containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Interest in AI-driven tooling for engineering workflows.

  • Interest in crypto and blockchain technologies.

Job Benefits

> How we work:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

> Learning & Development:

  • $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As Kalshi scales, we are looking for an experienced tax professional to build and own the tax function across the company.

You will own federal and state income tax compliance, state tax examinations, ASC 740 provision support, excise and transaction-tax positions, information reporting, international tax planning, and relationships with external tax advisors.

This is a builder role for someone who wants to create a tax function rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Do

  • Own federal, state, indirect, and international tax matters across Kalshi's entities

  • Oversee federal consolidated and multistate income tax compliance and manage relationships with external tax preparers

  • Take end-to-end ownership of state tax examinations and controversy matters, including response strategy, document production, deadlines, and coordination with outside advisors

  • Develop and maintain Kalshi's positions on federal and state excise and transaction-based taxes, including research, documentation, and monitoring of regulatory developments

  • Own ASC 740 tax provision support and tax-related financial statement disclosures in partnership with Technical Accounting

  • Build and maintain a comprehensive tax calendar covering federal, state, international, and information-reporting obligations

  • Drive tax planning for new products, new markets, international expansion, and entity-structuring decisions

  • Evaluate VAT, GST, withholding, transfer pricing, nexus, and apportionment considerations as the business expands

  • Own information reporting, including 1099 processes and customer tax documentation

  • Direct and challenge external tax advisors, including PwC and EY, while managing scopes, budgets, and auditor-independence requirements

  • Partner closely with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and business teams on novel tax questions in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment

  • Determine how the tax function should evolve over time, including what capabilities should remain outsourced and where Kalshi should build internally

What You Bring

  • 10–15 years of progressive tax experience in public accounting, industry, or a combination of both

  • Active US CPA

  • Deep corporate income tax expertise with hands-on ASC 740 experience in a PCAOB-audited environment

  • Strong multistate and SALT experience, including meaningful exposure to tax audits, examinations, or controversy

  • Experience operating in complex, transaction-heavy businesses; financial services, fintech, exchanges, or similar environments are particularly relevant

  • The ability to independently develop and defend tax positions where precedent may be limited or evolving

  • Experience directing Big 4 or other external advisors and the judgment to challenge recommendations rather than simply defer to them

  • Strong written communication skills and experience producing tax positions and documentation that can withstand scrutiny from auditors and tax authorities

  • Comfort operating in a highly regulated environment and partnering with Legal when tax issues intersect with regulatory or litigation matters

  • A builder mentality and willingness to operate as the primary in-house tax expert while establishing the function

  • Exposure to excise taxes, transaction-based taxes, and information reporting is strongly preferred

  • International tax experience, including VAT/GST, withholding, or transfer pricing, is a plus

  • Experience preparing a company for an IPO or operating within a public-company tax function is a strong plus

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure:

Salary Range: $200,000 to $300,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Kalshi is committed to creating a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe it is our collective responsibility to uphold these values and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to join us in our mission. All qualified applicants will be treated with respect and receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, uniform service, veteran status, age, or any other protected characteristic per federal, state, or local law. If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Offer

descriptions.job-0leto3h:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Technical Consultants are on the frontlines working to establish partnerships with Ramp customers, and act as a liaison between customers and our internal technical teams. You'll be partnering with Customer Activation & Account Management teams to identify, prioritize and build financial solutions for new and existing customers so that Ramp continues to scale with their needs.

You will act as the technical and financial subject matter expert for our customers and design solutions that address the customer's needs through Ramp and partner integrations. You will partner with Post-Sales teams to drive Product, Design and Engineering teams' roadmaps to evolve Ramp to better serve our customers at scale and offer increasingly higher value.

You will define the customer's financial & technical success criteria from onboarding through activation and expansion. You will represent Product, Design, and Engineering externally and will operate with deep conviction and understanding of Ramp's technical capabilities. The role requires technical skills necessary to understand and educate on robust accounting features and integrate them across all the touchpoints and surface area of a customer.

This role is specifically focused on Enterprise customers running Oracle Fusion Cloud, supporting large, complex organizations with multi-entity environments, advanced ERP integrations, and highly customized financial workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary Technical Consultant for Enterprise accounts running Oracle Cloud, supporting complex, high-impact customers with multi-entity, multi-ERP, and global financial environments

  • Act as a technical advisor to customers and Ramp's internal teams while supporting high-value implementations and expansion opportunities by guiding Oracle Cloud integration, configuration, and system design

  • Partner with Customer Activation and Account Management teams to assess customer requirements and propose scalable solutions involving Oracle Cloud, HRIS, and API integrations

  • Collaborate with onboarding specialists and implementation leads to support technical workstreams, ensuring faster time-to-value and customer success

  • Work with customers to problem-solve technical hurdles and propose effective product implementations with a deep understanding of Oracle Cloud integration and configuration options

  • Be a subject matter expert across Oracle Cloud and Ramp's accounting integration capabilities, partnering with Sales, Product and partners to advocate for integration development aligned with customer needs

  • Troubleshoot Oracle Cloud integration blockers and guide customers through complex configuration decisions

  • Contribute to internal documentation and tooling that scales Ramp's ability to support Oracle Cloud integration use cases across a growing customer base

What You Need

  • Deep familiarity with Oracle Cloud Financials accounting workflows, including core functionalities involving General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Subledger Accounting, and multi-org structures

  • Comfort working with APIs, integration logic, and system architecture and being able to explain those concepts to finance and operations stakeholders

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design on enterprise-driven gaps, influencing roadmap decisions that unlock scale across Ramp's largest customers

  • Strong communication skills: able to translate complex technical solutions into business value and guide customers toward scalable approaches

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering

  • Exceptional organization and problem-solving skills, with a bias toward action and a high level of ownership

descriptions.job-1r4ecfx:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Platform Sales team works with B2B Software Platforms to help them facilitate payments for their customers using our Stripe Connect product. Software Platforms, also known as B2B Indirect, are software platform businesses who serve other businesses. Platforms already using Stripe include Shopify, Lightspeed and Mindbody.

As a key member to the Stripe Platforms team, you will navigate complex organizations and identify ways Stripe can exceed expectations. We’re building something new, developing our sales process, our value proposition and assisting in the creation of key tools and assets, we’re looking for pioneers to join us on this adventure. 

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

What you’ll do

As a Platform Account Executive for the Southeast Asia region, you will create partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing software platforms in the world by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.

You will navigate complex organisations and identify ways Stripe can help them monetise financial services across their business. We’re early in building this specialisation with the need to develop our sales process, refine the value proposition and create localised set of key tools and assets. We’re looking for pioneers to join us on this adventure! 

If you’re motivated, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to close for upper middle market and enterprise companies to showcase Stripe value in competitive processes, and consultatively apply highly-technical product knowledge from Stripe solutions
  • Identify and engage with high-potential existing SaaS Platforms, building long term, strategic relationships with them
  • Work with leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) at existing users to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses
  • Develop outbound strategies to create and nurture opportunities within Southeast Asia Market market
  • Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well
  • Develop relationships with executive stakeholders at new and existing clients

Who you are

You are an adept Enterprise salesperson, capable of engaging in business-level and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You have experience working with upper middle market and enterprise companies in Southeast Asia. You get excited about prospecting, and are capable of independently leading a sales cycle from start to finish. You have an in-depth understanding of the buyer journey and can lead a complex, multi-party sale in a highly consultative manner. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. You are naturally analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions. Finally, you enjoy building – you like to actively participate in the development of our sales process, the articulation of our value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of experience of directly selling a technology product or service to the Southeast Asia region at an API-first company, with a record of top performance
  • A proven track record of moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales. SaaS Platforms are trusting Stripe to help them monetise financial services, and you have demonstrated a consultative approach to sales, are quick to understand their potential monetisation strategy,  and are able to help your prospects articulate the value proposition of embedding financial services to create a SaaS Platform business unit.
  • Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies
  • An ability to understand complex technical problems and understand how Stripe’s solutions can address them. You are confident in understanding Stripe’s API and having technical discussion with support from Stripe engineers.
  • A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Strong interest in technology and fintech
  • Fastidious approach to CRM hygiene and experience utilizing thorough sales forecasting metrics on a weekly/quarterly basis and communicating them in a succinct manner

Preferred qualifications

  • Knowledge and understanding of existing and developing payments technologies
descriptions.job-00bxjzx:
About Chainlink
Chainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About The Role

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for Institutional Data Management, you own the commercial case for bringing high-value proprietary data onchain. You are the narrative and product marketing lead for institutional data providers and index owners, positioning Chainlink so they can reach onchain consumers without disrupting their existing licensing models or commercial structures.

This role runs on the distribution economics of financial data, a distinct institutional business with its own buyers and entrenched commercial structures. You own the segment's value chain, personas, and incumbent map, and the commercial case for the onchain consumers on the other side of the market. You lead product marketing for solutions like DataLink, showing how Chainlink respects institutional requirements while opening new onchain use cases and explore opportunities to shape and develop new data offerings to take to market. The goal is to make Chainlink the default reference layer for institutional data onchain.

Your Impact

  • Map the Data Value Chain: Document the end-to-end workflow for institutional data, from proprietary sources to on-chain smart contracts, and identify the commercial motivations for every participant.

  • Craft Distribution Narratives: Own the positioning for proprietary data distribution, making the commercial case for providers to publish onchain and for onchain consumers to adopt institutional data.

  • Develop Canonical Content: Create the "Product Marketing Playbook” and strategic inputs that fuel the content, events, and PR teams, ensuring a coherent and authoritative voice across all data-related touchpoints.

  • Competitive Governance: Maintain a definitive landscape of direct competitors, incumbents, and build-it-yourself alternatives, ensuring our GTM teams are equipped to differentiate Chainlink’s data solutions.

  • Shape Pricing & Packaging: Partner with Product and Sales to influence the commercial structures of our data offerings, ensuring they align with how institutional data is bought and sold.

Requirements

  • At least 6 years of experience in product marketing or strategy, with deep fluency in institutional data licensing, distribution, and commercial structures.

  • Proven ability to translate complex data workflows and technical distribution mechanics into clear, business-focused value propositions.

  • Understands how institutional data providers operate and what they require to publish onchain, and how the buy-side consumes that data onchain, from DeFi protocols today to other institutions over time.

  • Can build positioning that speaks to data providers' commercial realities, not just the technical capability (index providers, rating agencies, reference data vendors).

  • Proven experience owning GTM strategy and execution for successful platform or infrastructure launches.

  • Strong collaborative skills, with the ability to act as the "go-to" marketing lead for a complex category.

Preferred Requirements

  • Prior role at a major data vendor

  • Technical background or strong comfort working with data-heavy products and API-based distribution.

  • Familiarity with onchain data infrastructure, oracles, or how DeFi protocols consume external data.

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

We carefully review all applications and aim to provide a response to every candidate within two weeks after the job posting closes. The closing date is listed on the job advert, so we encourage you to take the time to thoughtfully prepare your application. We want to fully consider your experience and skills, and you will hear from us regarding the status of your application shortly after the closing date.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

Chainlink Labs is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, or ordinances. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us via this form.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Information collected and processed as part of your Chainlink Labs Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to our Recruiting Privacy Policy. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required.
descriptions.job-1ot30sd:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

The Growth team at Polymarket is building out a Customer Marketing function from the ground up, and lifecycle is central to that bet. We're not filling a coordinator seat. We're hiring a Lifecycle Director who will own the customer journey end-to-end, set the strategy, define the roadmap, and be accountable for the commercial outcomes that come out of it. You'll report directly to the Head of Customer Marketing and sit peer-level to other lifecycle owners on the team.

The assignment will be scoped to your strengths and where the business needs the most lift at the time of hire, across acquisition and onboarding to retention and reactivation. Either way, the mandate is the same: translate commercial goals into a lifecycle communication and engagement strategy that moves real metrics. You'll direct shared campaign and execution resources, partner with data and martech, and own the results narrative for your area.

This hire matters because lifecycle at Polymarket is still early. There's real opportunity to build something that doesn't exist yet, define the playbook, prove what works, and set the foundation for a team that scales with it. If you want ownership over a meaningful piece of a fast-growing consumer product with a clear line of sight from your work to revenue, this is the role.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategic roadmap for an assigned lifecycle stage, from goal-setting to execution oversight to results, with clear KPIs and a results narrative you write and defend.

  • Design customer journeys, messaging strategy, and engagement cadence across email, push, and SMS, iterating based on performance data and user behavior.

  • Brief and prioritize shared campaign execution resources against lifecycle goals, holding the team accountable to timelines and quality without direct management authority.

  • Partner with data and martech teams to instrument flows, validate test setups, and ensure you have clean measurement in place before campaigns go live.

  • Build a structured test-and-learn program for your lifecycle stage, with clear baselines, documented hypotheses, and a repeatable cadence that compounds over time.

  • Pull and analyze performance data regularly, connecting lifecycle metrics directly to retention curves, reactivation revenue, and LTV impact, not just open rates.

  • Develop a scalable playbook for your area that documents what works and sets the foundation for a dedicated execution hire as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, with direct ownership of a customer lifecycle stage and measurable commercial outcomes you can speak to specifically.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect lifecycle tactics to business outcomes. You think in terms of retention curves, reactivation revenue, and LTV, and you can show where you moved those numbers.

  • Experience directing execution talent in a shared or matrixed environment. You know how to brief, prioritize, and hold martech, data, and creative teams accountable without a direct reporting line.

  • A track record of structured experimentation. You build test-and-learn programs with clear baselines and hypotheses, not one-off A/B tests run when the timing felt right.

  • Strong written communication skills. You can write a clear strategy doc, a crisp creative brief, and a results narrative that tells a story without burying the point.

  • (Plus) Background building lifecycle programs at a high-growth consumer product, ideally one with a transactional or trading mechanic.

  • (Plus) Hands-on familiarity with Braze or a comparable ESP, and working knowledge of Hightouch or a similar customer data platform.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $175,000 to $225,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

descriptions.job-0n6nnlp:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Payward's Data team builds and operates the data infrastructure, pipelines, and analytics platforms that power decision-making, reporting, and controls across the business. The team partners closely with functions across the company, including Risk & Audit, IT, Finance, and Engineering, to make sure the data those functions depend on is reliable, well-governed, and ready to stand up to scrutiny.

This role sits within the Data & Audit Readiness team and is dedicated to supporting overall audit readiness from a data standpoint. You will own the inventories, playbooks, catalogs, and access processes that keep the Data team's systems and datasets audit ready, translating audit engagements directly into coordinated, well-documented responses. Because audit readiness is best designed rather than bolted on, this role calls for a data architect's background — someone who has built data pipelines before and knows how to shape them for traceability, access control, and testability from day one. This is a hands-on, builder's role where you will build the ETL pipelines, dashboards, and audit-ready data architecture that let Internal Audit turn audit and review planning into data-driven testing.

The opportunity

  • Collaborate on the technical coordination and stewardship layer for shared datasets and systems in scope for audit, including financial systems, recordkeeping, and downstream reporting processes.

  • Spearhead improvements to governance, communication, and coordination around upstream schema and logic changes that impact downstream systems and audit-related processes.

  • Support technical analysis and downstream impact assessment during the change management process to improve downstream visibility for datasets, tables, and systems in scope for audit.

  • Support the development and maintenance of reusable audit-ready dataset patterns, including automated validation, data quality checks, and monitoring.

  • Review processes and datasets in scope for Audit, examine existing operational pain points, and propose reengineering opportunities and longer-term process improvements.

  • Provide technical guidance to business stakeholders and the Audit PM around specific Audit requests.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in data analytics or data engineering, ideally supporting internal audit, risk, or SOX compliance functions within the fintech, payments, financial market or crypto where data quality and scale are non-negotiable.

  • Experience managing and designing data architecture in a regulated environment, having designed and built data pipelines with governance, traceability, and audit requirements considered from the outset.

  • Hands-on experience building and owning production data pipelines, with strong familiarity with dbt and Airflow or equivalent orchestration tools.

  • Full mastery of SQL including complex joins, CTEs and analytical functions, alongside strong Python proficiency for pipeline development and analysis.

  • Experience documenting technical and business requirements, including metadata, KPI definitions, business rules, data process flows, and data dictionaries.

  • Familiarity with data administration tasks: job scheduling, error/exception handling, and troubleshooting production ETL workflows.

  • Experience partnering with Data Engineering and/or Data Governance teams on shared datasets, schema changes, and downstream impact analysis.

  • Strong communicator who can translate audit and business requirements into technical specifications and translate technical work back into terms non-technical stakeholders understand.

Nice to haves

  • Experience building or scaling a data analytics function within an audit or risk organization from the ground up.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted or automation tools for data quality checks, testing, or workflow efficiency.

  • Familiarity with audit management platforms (e.g., AuditBoard, Jira, Workiva).

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment
